Existing methods rely on answer voting and therefore do not extend naturally to open-ended generation, where valid responses cannot be mapped to a shared canonical answer. Without external reward models or stronger judges, adaptation must instead construct reliable rewards from the model's own outputs. We introduce SERPO (Self-Evolving Rubric Policy Optimization), which replaces answer voting with a closed loop that co-evolves response evidence, query-specific rubrics, and policy parameters. Good-Normal-Bad (G-N-B) response evolution organizes maximally separated rollouts into ordered archives; rubric evolution retains criteria that discriminate these archives; probabilistic criterion scoring converts verdict-token likelihoods into reward signals; and policy evolution optimizes the actor with the resulting signals. New actor rollouts then refresh both the archives and rubrics, closing the three-way evolution loop. Across two model configurations, two in-domain benchmarks, and four OOD benchmarks, SERPO improves HealthBench and ResearchQA by up to 20.63 and 20.31 points over the corresponding base models, raises the six-benchmark macro-average by up to 8.06 points, and supports OOD transfer and continued cross-benchmark evolution.
articles.comment: 20 pages, including the appendix. Code is available at https://github.com/chiefovoavicii/SERPO
articles.titleCn: SERPO：面向开放式测试时强化学习的自进化评分政策优化
articles.abstractCn: 测试时强化学习（TTRL）使语言模型能够在推理时无需标记反馈进行自我进化。现有方法依赖于答案投票，因此无法自然地扩展到开放式生成，其中有效响应无法映射到共享的规范答案。在没有外部奖励模型或更强的判别者的情况下，适应必须从模型自身的输出中构建可靠的奖励。我们引入了SERPO（自我进化的评分策略优化），它用闭环取代了答案投票，共同进化响应证据、特定于查询的评分标准和策略参数。良好-正常-差（G-N-B）响应进化将最大程度分离的运行组织成有序的存档；评分标准进化保留区分这些存档的标准；概率标准评分将裁决标记的似然转换为奖励信号；策略进化优化了使用这些信号的演员。新的演员运行然后刷新存档和评分标准，关闭了这三向进化循环。在两个模型配置、两个领域内基准测试和四个领域外基准测试中，SERPO使HealthBench和ResearchQA相对于相应的基线模型分别提高了高达20.63和20.31分，将六个基准测试的宏平均值提高了高达8.06分，并支持领域外迁移和持续的跨基准测试进化。

articles.title: From Representations to Behaviors: Exploring the Person-Situation-Behavior Triad in LLMs
articles.abstract: Human personality theories characterize traits not as isolated attributes captured by a single score, but as stable individual tendencies expressed through the interplay among persons, situations, and behaviors. Existing studies of personality-related behavior in LLMs have primarily focused on outputs elicited under personality conditioning, characterizing observable trait-related expressions while lacking mechanistic evidence for the existence of internal personality-related representations, their cross-situational expression, and how these representations shape specific behaviors. Building on Funder's personality triad framework, we adapt its three components for LLM analysis: Person as personality-related internal representations, Situation as contexts that afford trait-relevant responses, and Behavior as response patterns on broader social tasks. We introduce a framework for discovering, controlling, and validating trait-like representations in LLMs. First, using contrastive behavior pairs grounded in shared situations, we identify sparse internal features associated with opposing poles of personality traits through SAE decomposition. We validate their trait relevance through effects on behavior to situation, token-level activation patterns, and robustness to paraphrasing. Second, feature-level interventions induce bidirectional trait-related shifts across a separate, diverse set of situations while preserving response validity, demonstrating consistent expression across contexts. Third, applying the same interventions to social intelligence tasks reveals behavioral changes with benefit-tradeoff patterns consistent with findings from human personality research, providing behavioral-level validation beyond personality scores. Our findings provide evidence that LLMs contain controllable trait-like representations linking internal states, situational expression, and behavioral outcomes.
articles.titleCn: 从表征到行为：探索LLMs中的人-情境-行为三元组
articles.abstractCn: 人格理论将特质描述为稳定个体倾向，这些倾向通过人与人、情境与行为之间的相互作用得以表达，而非单一分数所捕捉的孤立属性。现有关于大型语言模型（LLM）中人格相关行为的研究主要集中于人格条件下的输出，描述了可观察的特质相关表达，但缺乏内部人格相关表征存在、跨情境表达及其如何塑造特定行为的机制证据。基于Funder的人格三元框架，我们将其三个组成部分调整为LLM分析：个体作为人格相关内部表征，情境作为提供特质相关反应的环境，行为作为更广泛社会任务中的反应模式。我们引入了一个发现、控制和验证LLM中特质相关表征的框架。首先，利用基于共享情境的对比行为对，通过自编码器（SAE）分解识别与人格特质对立两极相关的稀疏内部特征。我们通过行为对情境的影响、token级激活模式以及对抗释义的鲁棒性来验证其特质相关性。其次，特征级干预在另一组多样化情境中诱导双向特质相关转变，同时保持响应有效性，展示了跨情境的一致表达。第三，将相同干预应用于社会智能任务，揭示了与人类人格研究发现的利益权衡模式一致的行为变化，提供了超越人格分数的行为级验证。我们的研究结果表明，LLM中存在可控的特质相关表征，将内部状态、情境表达和行为结果联系起来。

articles.title: Language Models are not Equally Robust to Non-Canonical Tokenization across Languages
articles.abstract: Despite the existence of exponentially many valid tokenizations for a given string, language models operate on a single canonical sequence deterministically produced by the tokenizer, leaving the broader tokenization space largely uncharacterized. In this paper, we investigate this overlooked space by studying the behavior of language models under non-canonical tokenizations across diverse languages. For English, prior work shows that models are largely invariant to alternative tokenizations that represent the same underlying string. We ask whether this invariance generalizes to other languages beyond English. We conduct a multilingual study across 27 languages spanning diverse scripts and evaluate LLM behavior under alternative tokenizations across six downstream tasks. We find that tokenization invariance does not generalize: model behavior varies substantially across languages with instruction-tuned models exhibiting an average relative performance drop of 23.7% for Llama-3.1-8B, 11.4% for Qwen3-8B, and 9.9% for Gemma-3-12B. The variation of tokenization invariance is systematic across languages. Languages that exhibit higher token fragmentation show significantly greater sensitivity to non-canonical tokenizations. Our study of tokenization robustness serves as a diagnostic of how tightly a model is coupled to its tokenizer. These results demonstrate that tokenization robustness is not a universal property of language models, but depends strongly on the language and its interaction with the tokenizer. We also show that LoRA fine-tuning with multi-tokenization training data provides an effective mitigation for tokenization sensitivity. Fine-tuning on English alone improves tokenization robustness across languages, while systematically sampling diverse non-canonical tokenizations achieves the strongest overall performance.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型在不同语言的非标准分词方式下并非同等稳健
articles.abstractCn: 尽管给定字符串存在指数级的有效分词方式，语言模型仅基于由分词器确定性地生成的单一规范序列进行操作，从而使得更广泛的分词空间在很大程度上未被表征。本文通过研究语言模型在不同语言中非规范分词下的行为，探究了这一被忽视的空间。对于英语，已有研究表明模型对表示相同底层字符串的替代分词方式基本保持不变。我们提出这种不变性是否适用于英语以外的其他语言。我们进行了一项跨27种语言的多元研究，这些语言涵盖不同的文字系统，并在六个下游任务中评估了大型语言模型在替代分词下的行为。我们发现分词不变性并不具有普适性：模型行为在不同语言间差异显著，其中指令微调模型在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-3-12B上的平均相对性能分别下降了23.7%、11.4%和9.9%。分词不变性的差异在不同语言间呈现系统性特征。表现出更高分词碎片化的语言对非规范分词的敏感性显著增强。我们对分词鲁棒性的研究可作为诊断模型与其分词器耦合紧密程度的依据。这些结果表明分词鲁棒性并非语言模型的普遍属性，而是强烈依赖于语言及其与分词器的交互。我们还表明，使用多分词训练数据的LoRA微调可有效缓解分词敏感性。仅在英语上进行微调可提升跨语言的分词鲁棒性，而系统性地采样多样化的非规范分词则实现了最佳整体性能。

articles.title: From Found to Designed: Concepts as a Design Axis for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) encode rich concept-like information, but represent it implicitly through distributed statistical associations rather than as explicit, structured, compositional concepts. Consequently, concept-level structure is typically \emph{found} rather than \emph{designed}: it is recovered after training through probing or dictionary learning, with no architectural guarantee of stability, compositionality, controllability, or alignment with human conceptual organization. We organize concept-aware interventions along two dimensions: whether concept structure is internally induced or externally grounded, and the stage of the pipeline where it is introduced. This taxonomy reveals three broad patterns: inference-time approaches remain comparatively underexplored, related ideas have developed largely in isolation across pipeline stages, and externally grounded methods span the entire pipeline despite often being described under different terminology. Together, these observations motivate moving beyond recovering concept-like structure from trained models toward designing LLMs with explicit conceptual representations.
articles.titleCn: 从发现到设计：概念作为大型语言模型的设计轴
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）编码了丰富的类似概念的信息，但并非以明确、结构化、组合式的概念形式来表示，而是通过分布式统计关联隐式地呈现。因此，概念层面的结构通常是\emph{被发现的}而非\emph{被设计的}：它是在训练后通过探测或字典学习来恢复的，缺乏架构层面的稳定性、组合性、可控性或与人类概念组织的对齐性。我们将概念感知干预沿着两个维度进行组织：概念结构是内部诱导的还是外部奠定的，以及它被引入管道的哪个阶段。这种分类揭示了三种广泛的模式：推理时方法相对而言仍较少探索，相关理念主要在管道的不同阶段独立发展，而外部奠定的方法尽管常以不同术语描述，却贯穿整个管道。这些观察共同促使我们超越从训练模型中恢复类似概念结构，转向设计具有明确概念表示的LLMs。

articles.title: When Does Span-Guided Detoxification Help? Human Preferences and Evaluator Diagnostics in a Controlled Comparison
articles.abstract: Span-guided rewriting aims to preserve meaning by localizing edits to annotated harmful spans, but the same constraint can leave harmful intent insufficiently mitigated. We present a controlled exploratory comparison of span-guided and unguided detoxification on a mixed-source English evaluation set comprising manually curated inputs and HateXplain test items. We conduct a dense blinded human evaluation under a fixed single-generator setting. Human preferences reveal a trade-off rather than a uniformly superior rewriting strategy. Span-guided outputs are favored when localized editing preserves the original stance and avoids unnecessary modification, whereas unguided outputs are favored when broader rewriting achieves more complete mitigation. This contrast varies substantially across the study-defined strata: the two strategies are competitive in the strong stratum, while unguided rewriting is clearly preferred in the mild stratum. Rationale annotations trace this difference to complementary failure risks: residual harm after localized editing and over-modification after broader rewriting. We treat automatic evaluation as a diagnostic rather than a substitute for human judgment. Toxicity-similarity scalarizations, a multi-generator analysis, and two general-purpose LLM judges reproduce parts of the aggregate tendency but do not yield an analogous stratified contrast. These setting-specific findings do not establish a severity-based routing rule. Instead, they motivate evaluation protocols that assess mitigation sufficiency and meaning preservation separately and report both residual harm and over-modification alongside aggregate scores.
articles.titleCn: 何时Span-Guided Detoxification有帮助？人类偏好与评估器诊断在受控比较中的表现
articles.abstractCn: 基于片段的改写旨在通过将修改定位到标注的有害片段来保留意义，但同样的约束可能使有害意图的缓解不足。我们针对一个包含人工编辑输入和HateXplain测试项目的混合来源英语评估集，对基于片段和无引导的解毒方法进行了受控的探索性比较。在固定的单一生成器设置下，我们进行了密集的盲法人工评估。人类偏好揭示了一种权衡，而非一种普遍优越的改写策略。当局部编辑保留原始立场并避免不必要的修改时，基于片段的输出更受青睐；而当更广泛的改写实现了更彻底的缓解时，无引导的输出更受青睐。这种对比在研究定义的层级中差异很大：两种策略在强层级中具有竞争力，而无引导的改写在温和层级中明显更受青睐。理由注释将这种差异归因于互补的失败风险：局部编辑后的残余伤害和更广泛改写后的过度修改。我们将自动评估视为对人类判断的诊断，而非替代。毒性相似度标度化、多生成器分析以及两个通用的大型语言模型裁判部分地再现了总体趋势，但并未产生类似的层级对比。这些特定设置的发现并未建立基于严重程度的路由规则。相反，它们促使评估协议分别评估缓解充分性和意义保留，并在综合分数之外报告残余伤害和过度修改。

articles.title: SecRespond: Benchmarking AI Agents for Real-World Post-Compromise Incident Response
articles.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly adopted in real-world security operations with access to host artifacts and command-line interfaces (CLIs), making it critical to thoroughly assess their security capabilities. However, existing cybersecurity benchmarks focus on pre-compromise settings where agents are placed in a clean and idealized environment before an attack occurs. This leaves the post-compromise setting underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce SecRespond, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on the post-compromise incident-response workflow. Given a forensic disk snapshot of a compromised host together with the alerts, vulnerability scans, and baseline checks reported by a host security product, agents are required to produce forensic reports on intrusions, baseline risks, and vulnerability risks, together with a remediation plan. We instantiate this task across 10 cyber ranges, each constructed from a distinct compromised cloud host, spanning 4 entry-point types, 21 ATT&CK techniques, and 5 operating systems. We evaluate 23 frontier LLMs on the OpenCode agent harness. Experimental results show that although current agents can reliably uncover the problems exposed by alerts, they struggle to proactively investigate the disk for silent intrusions and to produce comprehensive, verified remediation plans, with no model achieving complete detection and remediation on any single range. This reveals a fundamental bottleneck in building agents for real-world incident response. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr/tree/main/data/secrespond.
articles.titleCn: SecRespond：针对现实世界妥协后事件响应的AI代理基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理在现实世界安全操作中越来越多地被采用，并能够访问主机工件和命令行界面（CLI），这使得全面评估其安全能力变得至关重要。然而，现有的网络安全基准主要关注事前攻击环境，即在攻击发生前将代理置于干净和理想化的环境中。这使得事后攻击环境的研究不足。为填补这一空白，我们引入了SecRespond，这是首个用于评估LLM代理在事后应急响应工作流程中的基准。给定一个受感染主机的取证磁盘快照，以及主机安全产品报告的警报、漏洞扫描和基线检查，代理需要生成关于入侵、基线风险和漏洞风险的取证报告，并附带修复计划。我们在10个网络靶场中实例化了这项任务，每个靶场由一个独特的受感染云主机构建，涵盖4种入口点类型、21种ATT&CK技术以及5种操作系统。我们在OpenCode代理框架上评估了23个前沿LLM。实验结果表明，尽管当前代理能够可靠地发现警报暴露的问题，但它们难以主动调查磁盘以发现隐蔽入侵，并生成全面、经过验证的修复计划，没有任何模型在任何单个靶场中实现完全检测和修复。这揭示了构建现实世界应急响应代理的根本瓶颈。该基准可在https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr/tree/main/data/secrespond上公开获取。

articles.title: Enhancing Generative Information Extraction with Two-step Validation: A Product Attribute Use Case
articles.abstract: The ability of large language models (LLMs) to process and generate text has introduced potential for applications in information extraction (IE). While it's debated whether LLMs outperform smaller fine-tuned models for classification tasks, their strong generalization capability makes them promising for domains with limited labeled data available for fine-tuning. This advantage is particularly relevant for the emerging application of the digital product passport (DPP), where the problem space is broad but domain-specific data remains scarce. Motivated by this use case, we apply generative IE to the product domain, explicitly addressing efficiency, generalizability, and data privacy constraints. We propose a two-step validation method that integrates a PLM block into the generative IE pipeline and thereby leverages LLMs' correction capability. We discover that such a validation task enhances LLM performance, particularly on the extraction of weakly expressed, low-salience entities that appear sparsely throughout the text. For certain entities, the performance of mid-size models can even reach levels comparable to larger models, and the improvement of first-step PLM predictions also enhance the final LLM output. Nevertheless, the effects on the smallest open-source LLMs (e.g., Llama-3.2 3B) is limited. Based on the findings, we develop a demo application for product information extraction that utilizes locally deployed LLMs, targeting further adaptations to real-world DPP use cases.
articles.titleCn: 基于两步验证增强生成式信息抽取：产品属性应用案例
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在处理和生成文本方面的能力为信息抽取（IE）应用带来了潜力。尽管LLM在分类任务上是否优于较小的微调模型存在争议，但它们强大的泛化能力使它们在缺乏用于微调的标记数据的领域具有前景。这一优势对于新兴的数字产品护照（DPP）应用尤其相关，因为该问题领域广泛但特定领域的数据仍然稀缺。受此用例的启发，我们将生成式IE应用于产品领域，明确解决效率、泛化能力和数据隐私限制问题。我们提出了一种两步验证方法，将PLM模块集成到生成式IE流程中，从而利用LLM的纠错能力。我们发现此类验证任务增强了LLM的性能，尤其是在提取文本中稀疏出现的弱表达、低显著性实体方面。对于某些实体，中等规模模型的性能甚至可以达到与大型模型相当的水平，第一步PLM预测的改进也提升了最终的LLM输出。然而，对最小开源LLM（例如Llama-3.2 3B）的影响有限。基于这些发现，我们开发了一个用于产品信息抽取的演示应用，该应用利用本地部署的LLM，旨在进一步适应现实世界的DPP用例。

articles.title: MediaWiki Code2Code Search: Neural Retrieval for the Semantic Discovery of Open-Source Software Entities
articles.abstract: Code search in large-scale ecosystems is often hindered by the lexical gap between user queries and implementation details, alongside the trade-off between the low latency of traditional Information Retrieval (IR) and the precision of Deep Learning (DL). We present MediaWiki Code2Code Search, a neural retrieval system for semantic code-to-code discovery. By indexing 1.29 million structural entities (functions, types, and templates) across 2,500+ MediaWiki repositories, our system enables retrieval based on computational intent rather than surface tokens. We employ a split-build architecture, decoupling GPU-intensive offline indexing from a CPU-only serving layer; our FAISS IVF-PQ index occupies 168.6 MB: a 96.6\% reduction compared to a flat float32 baseline, and achieves a median query latency of 1.85 seconds on commodity hardware, satisfying the 6 GiB RAM constraint of Wikimedia Toolforge. Our evaluation across a 27-query benchmark demonstrates superior performance over the BM25 baseline, achieving a P@10 of 0.87 compared to 0.64 (0.52 versus 0.34 for strict matching). Gains are most pronounced in name-obfuscated tasks where lexical methods fail. The system is available at https://code2codesearch.toolforge.org under the Apache 2.0 licence and provides an open RESTful API.
articles.titleCn: MediaWiki代码到代码搜索：用于开源软件实体语义发现的神经检索
articles.abstractCn: 在大规模生态系统中的代码搜索常常受到用户查询与实现细节之间的词汇差距的阻碍，同时传统的信息检索（IR）的低延迟与深度学习（DL）的精确性之间存在权衡。我们提出了MediaWiki Code2Code Search，这是一个用于语义代码到代码发现的神经检索系统。通过索引2,500多个MediaWiki存储库中的1.29百万个结构实体（函数、类型和模板），我们的系统能够基于计算意图而非表面标记进行检索。我们采用分建架构，将GPU密集型的离线索引与仅CPU的服务层解耦；我们的FAISS IVF-PQ索引占用168.6 MB：与扁平float32基线相比减少了96.6%，并在普通硬件上实现了1.85秒的中位数查询延迟，满足了Wikimedia Toolforge的6 GiB RAM限制。我们在一个包含27个查询的基准测试中的评估表明，其性能优于BM25基线，实现了0.87的P@10，而BM25为0.64（严格匹配为0.52对比0.34）。在名称混淆任务中，这种优势最为显著，而词汇方法在此类任务中失效。该系统可在https://code2codesearch.toolforge.org上获取，遵循Apache 2.0许可证，并提供开放的RESTful API。

articles.title: Relation Geometry in Semantic Space of Language Models
articles.abstract: When it comes to generating vector representations of words, current language models are achieving high-quality results. However, what is not known is the extent to which knowledge about semantic relations is represented in the geometry of the semantic spaces created in this way. In order to answer this question, we study the relation geometry of such semantic spaces from three perspectives. We first examine whether words standing in a particular relation to a target word~(called relata) occupy the same region in semantic space, and whether the regions corresponding to different relations are distinct from each other. We then verify to what extent semantic spaces reflect certain well-known properties of relations, such as symmetry, asymmetry, and transitivity. Finally, we consider which information about the target words and relata is more important for relation geometry: their surface forms, or their contexts. We conduct experiments on six semantic relations using causal, masked, and diffusion language models. The results show that relata in asymmetric relations relatively clearly occupy a distinct region in semantic space. Asymmetric relations' properties are only moderately well encoded in the semantic space, yet better than those of symmetric ones. Furthermore, when considering the question which information source has the strongest impact on results amongst the models we evaluated, we find that lexical information tends to be more important for the causal language model, whereas contextual information is more important for the masked and diffusion language models. Our results empirically show that relation geometry is not equally well-represented for all relations in semantic space, suggesting that there is a difference in how well semantic relations might be learned from distributional information alone.
articles.titleCn: 语言模型语义空间中的关系几何
articles.abstractCn: 在生成词语的向量表示方面，当前的语言模型已取得高质量的成果。然而，尚不清楚语义关系知识在由此构建的语义空间几何结构中得到了多大程度的体现。为了解答这一问题，我们从三个方面研究此类语义空间的关系几何。我们首先考察与目标词（称为relata）处于特定关系中的词语是否占据语义空间中的同一区域，以及对应不同关系的区域是否相互区分。接着，我们验证语义空间在多大程度上反映了关系的一些已知属性，如对称性、非对称性和传递性。最后，我们探讨目标词和relata的信息中，哪些对于关系几何更为重要：是它们的表层形式，还是它们的上下文。我们使用因果语言模型、掩码语言模型和扩散语言模型在六种语义关系上进行了实验。结果表明，非对称关系中的relata相对清晰地占据语义空间中的不同区域。非对称关系的属性在语义空间中的编码程度仅中等，但优于对称关系。此外，在考虑哪种信息源对所评估模型的结果影响最强的问题时，我们发现词汇信息对因果语言模型更为重要，而上下文信息对掩码语言模型和扩散语言模型更为重要。我们的结果从经验上表明，关系几何在语义空间中对所有关系并非同等程度地得到体现，这表明仅从分布信息中学习语义关系可能存在差异。

articles.title: Metis: Memory Foundation Model
articles.abstract: Recent advances in AI agents have increasingly internalized native capabilities into their underlying foundation models, giving rise to multimodal foundation models and large reasoning models. However, agent memory is still primarily implemented through external modules, leaving the native memory capability largely unexplored. In this paper, we take a first step toward this direction by introducing memory foundation models, which empower foundation models with native memory capabilities. We formalize native memory from two perspectives: a persistent and dynamically evolving memory state within the backbone, and native memory procedures that autonomously store and utilize information through model computation. We show that native memory offers advantages in architecture, end-to-end optimization, and efficiency. Based on this formulation, we propose Metis, the first prototype of memory foundation models. Metis introduces a new architecture that equips a foundation model with a native memory state, allowing historical information to be compressed into the model and accessed through memory attention. We construct large-scale memory-specific training data and introduce multiple optimization objectives to acquire these native memory procedures through mid-training. The online memory maintenance of Metis is gradient-free, and the memory update requires only a forward pass. At inference time, all learned model weights remain frozen, while the native memory states are autonomously transformed through standard forward computation. Through extensive experiments, we show that Metis exhibits native memory capabilities and further provide a detailed analysis of its strengths, limitations, and behaviors. To facilitate future research on memory foundation models, we release our project and model checkpoints.
articles.titleCn: Metis：记忆基础模型
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，AI代理在底层基础模型中日益内化原生能力，催生了多模态基础模型和大型推理模型。然而，代理内存仍主要通过外部模块实现，原生内存能力尚未得到充分探索。本文通过引入内存基础模型，迈出了探索这一方向的第一步，赋予基础模型原生内存能力。我们从两个角度对原生内存进行形式化定义：一是骨干中的持久且动态演化的内存状态，二是通过模型计算自主存储和利用信息的原生内存过程。我们证明原生内存在架构、端到端优化和效率方面具有优势。基于此定义，我们提出了Metis，即内存基础模型的首个原型。Metis引入了一种新架构，为基础模型配备原生内存状态，允许历史信息被压缩到模型中并通过内存注意力进行访问。我们构建了大规模针对内存的训练数据，并引入多个优化目标，在训练中获取这些原生内存过程。Metis的在线内存维护是无梯度的，内存更新仅需一次前向传递。在推理时，所有学习到的模型权重保持冻结，而原生内存状态则通过标准前向计算自主转换。通过大量实验，我们展示了Metis具备原生内存能力，并对其优势、局限性和行为进行了详细分析。为促进未来对内存基础模型的研究，我们发布了项目和模型检查点。

articles.title: Phoneme- vs. Character-Level Targets and Selective State-Space Models for Intracortical Brain-to-Text
articles.abstract: State-of-the-art intracortical brain-to-text systems pair a neural-sequence phone decoder with an external language model. Two design axes remain underexplored: whether selective state-space models (Mamba) improve on recurrent decoders, and how the output target (phonetic vs.\ character) interacts with that choice. On the public Brain-to-Text '25 benchmark, we study a controlled 2x2 grid (GRU vs.\ hybrid Mamba decoder; phonetic vs.\ character targets) trained with a CTC objective under one reproducible protocol. The recurrent baseline remains strongest: the best phonetic GRU reaches 12.62\% PER and 21.19\% WER, while the best textual GRU after LM rescoring reaches 13.39\% CER and 26.28\% WER. The Mamba hybrid is competitive but does not surpass it. Ablations isolate architectural contributions, and error analysis shows representation-dependent failures: articulatory-like phoneme confusions vs.\ lexical and word-boundary errors.

articles.titleCn: 音素级与字符级目标及选择性状态空间模型用于皮层内脑机文本转换
articles.abstractCn: 最先进的脑机接口文字转换系统将神经序列音素解码器与外部语言模型相结合。仍有两个设计方向有待探索：选择性状态空间模型（Mamba）是否优于循环解码器，以及输出目标（音素与字符）如何与该选择相互作用。在公开的Brain-to-Text '25基准测试中，我们研究了一个受控的2x2网格（GRU与混合Mamba解码器；音素与字符目标），并在一个可复现的协议下使用CTC目标进行训练。循环基线仍然最强：最佳音素GRU达到12.62% PER和21.19% WER，而经过LM重新评分的最佳文本GRU达到13.39% CER和26.28% WER。Mamba混合模型具有竞争力，但并未超越它。消融实验分离了架构贡献，错误分析显示表示相关的失败：发音类似音素混淆与词汇和词边界错误。

articles.title: AtmosERC: Modeling Dialogue-Level Affective Atmosphere for Emotion Recognition in Conversation
articles.abstract: Emotion Recognition in Conversation (ERC) aims to predict utterance-level emotions in dialogues and has largely advanced through context-centric modeling. However, global context is a heterogeneous signal, and not all contextual information is equally relevant to emotion prediction. This paper focuses on the affect-oriented component of this signal, termed dialogue-level affective atmosphere, which captures a latent tendency commonly reflected in conversational emotion patterns. To estimate and exploit this tendency, we propose AtmosERC, a graph-based ERC framework that models each dialogue as a conversational graph over utterances and speakers. A relation-aware graph extractor filters and fuses heterogeneous graph signals to produce dialogue-level and speaker-conditioned affective priors. The resulting compact prior guides lightweight sequential emotion prediction and can also be verbalized into prompt-level cues for LLM-based ERC without modifying backbone models. Experiments on four ERC benchmarks show that AtmosERC improves lightweight ERC, enhances LLM-based ERC as a plug-in cue, and yields more stable predictions under local emotional deviations.
articles.titleCn: AtmosERC：对话情感识别中的对话级情感氛围建模
articles.abstractCn: 对话中的情绪识别（ERC）旨在预测对话中的语句级情绪，并且主要通过以情境为中心的建模取得了显著进展。然而，全局情境是一种异构信号，并非所有情境信息都与情绪预测同等相关。本文聚焦于该信号的情感导向成分，称之为对话级情感氛围，它捕捉了通常反映在对话情绪模式中的潜在倾向。为了估计和利用这种倾向，我们提出了AtmosERC，这是一个基于图的ERC框架，将每个对话建模为一个由语句和说话者构成的对话图。关系感知图提取器过滤和融合异构图信号，生成对话级和说话者条件下的情感先验。由此产生的紧凑先验指导轻量级的序列情绪预测，并且还可以转化为基于LLM的ERC的提示级线索，而无需修改骨干模型。在四个ERC基准上的实验表明，AtmosERC改进了轻量级ERC，作为插件线索增强了基于LLM的ERC，并在局部情绪偏差下产生了更稳定的预测。

articles.title: Automated Multilabel Mpox Research Classification with Explainable Transformer Models
articles.abstract: The Mpox outbreak remains a serious public health issue, with the WHO (World Health Organization) reporting increasing cases in some regions. Research on Mpox is vital for several reasons, including vaccine development, diagnostic improvement, viral evolution studies, and preventing future outbreaks. However, the large amount of research being published makes it difficult to organize and analyze information efficiently. This study focuses on using multilabel classification to categorize 14590 Mpox research articles into key topics such as outbreaks, vaccination, and epidemiology. Among the different AI models tested, BERT performed the best, achieving 97.05% accuracy, 97.67% micro F1 score, and 96.46% macro F1 score. To better understand how the model makes decisions, SHAP was used to analyze significant word features and patterns. The results show that BERT can help automate the classification of Mpox research, making it easier for researchers, policymakers, and healthcare workers to quickly find relevant information, saving time and improving public health efforts.
articles.titleCn: 基于可解释Transformer模型的自动化多标签猴痘研究分类
articles.abstractCn: 猴痘疫情仍然是一个严重的公共卫生问题，世界卫生组织（WHO）报告称一些地区病例数量正在增加。对猴痘的研究至关重要，包括疫苗开发、诊断改进、病毒进化研究和预防未来疫情。然而，大量发表的研究使得有效组织和分析信息变得困难。本研究聚焦于使用多标签分类将14590篇猴痘研究文章归类到关键主题，如疫情、疫苗接种和流行病学。在测试的不同AI模型中，BERT表现最佳，达到97.05%的准确率、97.67%的微观F1分数和96.46%的宏观F1分数。为了更好地理解模型的决策过程，使用SHAP分析了显著词特征和模式。结果表明，BERT有助于自动化猴痘研究的分类，使研究人员、政策制定者和医疗工作者能够快速找到相关信息，节省时间并提升公共卫生工作。

articles.title: Scientific Knowledge Discovery in the Age of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: The rapid growth of scholarly literature has made identifying relevant publications increasingly difficult, and conventional search systems still depend heavily on manually formulated queries and effortful manual inspection. Generative large language models (LLMs) offer a more flexible alternative, supporting literature retrieval and the screening of candidate studies against eligibility criteria. This chapter surveys 34 peer-reviewed papers applying generative LLMs to these two tasks, identified via a Boolean search over the OpenAIRE Graph (1,589 records screened to 34 inclusions). Reviewed studies are characterised by LLMs employed, model access and adaptation, prompting and architectural techniques, ground-truth sources, and evaluation metrics.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型时代的科学知识发现
articles.abstractCn: 学术文献的快速增长使得识别相关出版物日益困难，而传统搜索系统仍然严重依赖人工编写的查询和费力的手动检查。生成式大型语言模型（LLMs）提供了一种更灵活的替代方案，支持文献检索以及根据纳入标准筛选候选研究。本章综述了34篇应用生成式LLMs于这两项任务的同行评审论文，通过在OpenAIRE图上执行布尔搜索（从1589条记录筛选至34篇纳入）确定。所综述的研究特征包括所使用的LLMs、模型访问与适配、提示与架构技术、真实标签来源以及评估指标。

articles.title: Constitutional Midtraining: Content Presence Drives Alignment Gains
articles.abstract: Post-training alignment is often shallow, eroding under fine-tuning. It remains untested as to whether constitutional midtraining interventions can produce durable alignment when cleanly isolated from post-training. We build a 394M-token constitutional corpus from Anthropic's Constitution and apply constitutional midtraining at 120B scale, where principled, values-based content is inserted into midtraining. A 2x2 design (curriculum ordering x deliberative reasoning) was used to produce four constitutionally midtrained conditions, plus a control, which were evaluated on self-generated and established benchmarks including alignment under pressure, value conflict resolution, blackmail, and emergent misalignment. All models were evaluated across three stages: post-midtraining, post-SFT, and post-benign fine-tuning. Constitutionally midtrained models outperformed the control on alignment generalization and durability, notably on blackmail: SFT instilled a blackmail propensity in all models, but constitutional midtraining blunted it, with the advantage surviving benign fine-tuning (-17.5pp). This durability did not extend to settings that required active resistance to in-context pressure or conflict, where the advantage attenuates after SFT. The presence of constitutional content at midtraining also mattered more than its structure, and constitutional midtraining incurred no capability cost, on average, at any stage (MMLU, ARC-Easy, piqa, GSM8K). A modest amount of constitutional content at midtraining could therefore yield broad, persistent alignment gains, offering a cheap, complementary addition to SFT-centered pipelines. Code, data, and models are available.
articles.titleCn: 宪法中期培训：内容存在推动一致性提升
articles.abstractCn: 训练后对齐通常较为浅层，在微调过程中容易被削弱。目前尚未验证，在完全隔离训练后的情况下，宪法性中途干预是否能够产生持久的对齐效果。我们从Anthropic的宪法中构建了一个包含3.94亿token的宪法性语料库，并在120B规模下应用宪法性中途训练，将基于原则、基于价值观的内容插入中途训练中。我们采用2x2设计（课程排序x审慎推理）生成了四个宪法性中途训练条件，加上一个对照组，并在自我生成和既定基准上进行了评估，包括压力下的对齐、价值观冲突解决、勒索和涌现性错位。所有模型均在三个阶段进行了评估：中途训练后、SFT后和良性微调后。宪法性中途训练的模型在对齐泛化和持久性方面优于对照组，尤其是在勒索方面：SFT在所有模型中培养了勒索倾向，但宪法性中途训练削弱了这种倾向，且这种优势在良性微调后依然存在（-17.5pp）。这种持久性并未扩展到需要主动抵抗情境压力或冲突的设置，在这些设置中，优势在SFT后减弱。中途训练中宪法内容的存在比其结构更重要，且宪法性中途训练在各个阶段平均没有能力成本（MMLU、ARC-Easy、piqa、GSM8K）。因此，在中途训练中包含适量的宪法内容可以带来广泛而持久的对齐增益，为以SFT为中心的流程提供了一种低成本、互补的补充。代码、数据和模型均已公开。

articles.title: Contrastive ESA: Human Evaluation of Multiple Translations at Once
articles.abstract: Current human evaluation of machine translation typically assesses single outputs in isolation, a paradigm that suffers from high annotator noise and cost. We introduce Contrastive Error Span Annotation (cESA), a protocol that presents multiple translations of the source input (text, video, audio, image). In cESA, the annotator sees multiple translations of the same document, marks major and minor error spans, and then assigns a score from 0% to 100% on absolute scale. By allowing annotators to access the shared context across multiple outputs, cESA facilitates more consistent and efficient judgments. We validate cESA using a large-scale human evaluation of English->Japanese translations of 12 models, demonstrating reductions in annotation time and noise compared to standard pointwise evaluation. Unlike existing contrastive ranking methods, cESA yields absolute quality judgments that enable simple, interpretable non-parametric model rankings without the need for post-hoc corrections.
articles.titleCn: 对比式ESA：一次性评估多份翻译
articles.abstractCn: 当前人类对机器翻译的评估通常独立地评估单个输出，这种范式存在标注者噪声高和成本高的问题。我们引入了对比错误片段标注（cESA）协议，该协议向标注者展示源输入（文本、视频、音频、图像）的多个翻译版本。在cESA中，标注者会看到同一文档的多个翻译版本，标记主要和次要错误片段，然后在绝对标尺上给出0%到100%的评分。通过允许标注者访问跨多个输出的共享上下文，cESA促进了更一致和高效的判断。我们使用大规模人类评估验证了cESA，该评估针对12个模型的英语→日语翻译，证明了与标准点式评估相比，cESA减少了标注时间和噪声。与现有的对比排序方法不同，cESA提供了绝对质量判断，能够实现简单、可解释的非参数模型排序，无需进行事后校正。

articles.title: Filesystem-Based Memory for LLM Agents: Organization, Evolution, and Sustainability

authors.name: Sheldon Yu
authors.affiliation: agent-organized hierarchy, verbatim dump, chunk retrieval

authors.name: Hui Wei
authors.affiliation: sandboxed shell, memory-tool-style functions, varied search tooling

articles.abstract: Deployed LLM agents increasingly keep their long-term memory as a filesystem: a directory tree of markdown files that the agent itself reads, writes, and reorganizes through generic file tools. Yet research has largely passed over this medium: prior systems design bespoke memory representations and study retrieval over them, leaving the default's two working assumptions untested: that an agent can keep a growing store organized as memories accumulate, conflict, and go stale, and that this organization pays. We present the first systematic exploration of filesystem-based memory for LLM agents. We formalize the setting as three roles around one memory filesystem: a management agent integrates and organizes incoming content, a search agent answers queries with cited sources, and an execution agent supplies task trajectories that are distilled into skills, unifying declarative memory and skills in a single store. Across long-conversation benchmarks and embodied tasks, we vary memory shape (agent-organized hierarchy, verbatim dump, chunk retrieval), stream scale, tool harness (sandboxed shell, memory-tool-style functions, varied search tooling), and the strengths of the management and search agents, tracking answer quality, cost, and store health as memory grows. What organization reliably buys is search economy: organized stores roughly halve retrieval cost where material is large. Today's agents, however, fall short of the default's promise: in our growth study, organization erodes for all but the strongest management agent, and no agent we measure converts organization itself into better answers. And the model is not the only lever over a store's shape: changing the tool set alone reshapes the store as strongly as swapping the model. The study turns the filesystem default from an assumption into a design space for agent memory.
articles.titleCn: 基于文件系统的内存用于大型语言模型代理：组织、演变与可持续性
articles.abstractCn: 部署的LLM代理越来越多地将长期记忆存储为文件系统：一个由代理自身通过通用文件工具读取、写入和重组的Markdown文件目录树。然而，研究在很大程度上忽略了这种媒介：先前的系统设计定制了记忆表示并研究其检索方式，留下了默认假设的两个工作前提未经检验：即代理能够随着记忆的积累、冲突和过时保持不断增长的记忆库的组织性，以及这种组织性是有价值的。我们首次对基于文件系统的LLM代理记忆进行了系统性的探索。我们将此场景形式化为围绕一个记忆文件系统的三个角色：管理代理整合和组织传入内容，搜索代理引用来源回答查询，执行代理提供提炼为技能的任务轨迹，将陈述性记忆和技能统一在单一存储中。在长对话基准测试和具身任务中，我们变化记忆形状（代理组织的层次结构、逐字转储、块检索）、流规模、工具套件（沙盒化shell、记忆工具式函数、多样化搜索工具）、以及管理和搜索代理的强度，跟踪记忆增长时的答案质量、成本和存储健康状况。可靠地带来效益的是搜索经济性：当材料较大时，组织化存储大约将检索成本减半。然而，当今的代理未能实现默认的承诺：在我们的增长研究中，组织性仅对最强的管理代理有效，而我们测量的所有代理都没有将组织性转化为更好的答案。并且模型并非是控制存储形状的唯一杠杆：仅改变工具套件就能与更换模型一样强烈地重塑存储。这项研究将文件系统默认从一种假设转变为代理记忆的设计空间。

articles.title: Revisiting Lossy Verification in Speculative Decoding: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Failure Modes
articles.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by allowing a lightweight draft model to propose tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by a larger target model. Recent approaches introduce lossy verification schemes to further improve efficiency by relaxing strict distributional matching. Yet such relaxation silently rewrites the decoding distribution, and the resulting acceleration can come at the cost of unstable, sometimes severely degraded generation quality. In this work, we present a principled analysis of the distributions induced by lossy verification methods. We show that many seemingly distinct approaches differ only superficially and can be classified into two categories: truncation-based verification and collaborative verification. We further construct a diagnostic evaluation framework across curated benchmarks. For truncation-based methods, we identify a fundamental pitfall: performance can degrade significantly compared to the true truncation sampling baseline due to distributional distortion. For collaborative verification, we uncover a key principles: controlling the overshoot of draft probabilities relative to target probabilities is essential to prevent low-quality outputs. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZhouYuxuanYX/Fast-HSD.
articles.titleCn: 重新审视推测解码中的有损验证：机制、权衡与失效模式
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码（SD）通过允许一个轻量级的草稿模型提出标记，并由一个更大的目标模型并行验证这些标记，从而加速大型语言模型的推理。最近的方法引入了有损验证方案，通过放宽严格的分布匹配来进一步提高效率。然而，这种放宽会默默地重写解码分布，而由此带来的加速可能会以生成质量不稳定、有时严重下降为代价。在这项工作中，我们对有损验证方法诱导的分布进行了原则性分析。我们表明，许多看似不同的方法在本质上只有表面差异，并且可以归入两类：基于截断的验证和协作验证。我们进一步构建了一个跨精选基准的诊断评估框架。对于基于截断的方法，我们识别了一个根本性的陷阱：由于分布扭曲，性能与真正的截断采样基线相比可能会显著下降。对于协作验证，我们揭示了一个关键原则：控制草稿概率相对于目标概率的 overshoot 对于防止低质量输出至关重要。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/ZhouYuxuanYX/Fast-HSD 获得。

articles.title: FedWeave: Rethinking the Unit of Specialization in Heterogeneous Federated MoE-LoRA
articles.abstract: Federated PEFT enables LLMs to collaboratively adapt to decentralized private data without sharing raw examples. However, task heterogeneity across clients can cause cross-task interference and gradient conflicts during aggregation. Federated MoE-LoRA addresses this challenge through specialized LoRA experts and conditional routing. Yet existing methods typically specialize at client granularity, implicitly assuming task-coherent clients. Our core insight is that experts need purity, namely pattern-coherent updates that preserve specialization, whereas routers need contrast, namely mixed-task observations that support expert comparison. We propose FedWeave, a framework that adopts asymmetric aggregation, separating expert aggregation from router optimization to meet these two requirements. FedWeave uses unsupervised prototype discovery to form local buckets and align them across clients, enabling prototype-level expert aggregation while retaining mixed-task client trajectories for router training. At inference, FedWeave performs sparse inference with one active expert while preserving nearly all soft-routing performance. Our theoretical analysis explains why asymmetric aggregation is advantageous: it controls expert convergence in stationarity through off-pattern contamination, identifies the consensus error induced by fragmented router trajectories, and bounds sparse-inference risk. On a heterogeneous multi-task benchmark with mainstream LLM backbones, FedWeave consistently outperforms strong baselines, while ablations verify the effectiveness of our design.
articles.titleCn: FedWeave：重新思考异构联邦MoE-LoRA中的专业化单元
articles.abstractCn: 联邦PEFT使大型语言模型能够协作适应去中心化的私有数据，而无需共享原始示例。然而，客户端之间的任务异质性会导致聚合过程中的跨任务干扰和梯度冲突。联邦MoE-LoRA通过专门的LoRA专家和条件路由来解决这一挑战。然而，现有方法通常在客户端粒度上进行专门化，隐含地假设任务一致的客户端。我们的核心洞察是，专家需要纯净性，即保持专业化的模式一致性更新，而路由器需要对比性，即支持专家比较的混合任务观察。我们提出了FedWeave，这是一个采用非对称聚合的框架，将专家聚合与路由器优化分离，以满足这两个要求。FedWeave使用无监督原型发现来形成本地桶并在客户端之间对齐，从而实现原型级别的专家聚合，同时保留混合任务的客户端轨迹以用于路由器训练。在推理时，FedWeave执行稀疏推理，仅使用一个活跃专家，同时保留几乎所有软路由性能。我们的理论分析解释了为什么非对称聚合是有优势的：它通过非模式污染控制专家的收敛性，识别由碎片化路由器轨迹引起的共识误差，并界定稀疏推理风险。在一个具有主流LLM主干的多任务异构基准上，FedWeave始终优于强大的基线，而消融实验验证了我们设计的有效性。

articles.title: WikiLoop: Jointly Learning to Build and Navigate Agent-Native Wikis with Downstream Feedback
articles.abstract: Knowledge-base construction and querying are typically optimized in isolation: retrieval-augmented agents operate over a fixed, externally maintained index, whereas construction receives no signal from downstream use. We present WikiLoop, a feedback-coupled framework that jointly learns to build and navigate an agent-native Wiki, a persistent linked-page knowledge base designed for machine navigation. A role-conditioned shared policy supports two interfaces: a Navigator retrieves evidence from the Wiki to answer queries, and a Builder proposes structured edits evaluated through downstream navigation. The Navigator follows a sufficiency-before-efficiency objective that applies retrieval-cost penalties only after full evidence has been collected. The Builder learns from utility differences: a frozen Navigator scores each candidate edit by its change in downstream performance, while a guard penalty discourages regressions on unrelated queries. Training combines sequential role-specific optimization with a final joint stage over role-homogeneous batches. With Qwen3.5-9B as the common backbone, WikiLoop reaches 62.6 aggregate Answer Correctness on AuthTrace, 6.3 points above LLM-Wiki, base, with the largest gains on multi-document queries. Controlled comparisons support the intended effects of both objectives, and the learned edits remain useful to a held-out Navigator. Paired comparisons indicate that the final shared policy largely retains both role-specific capabilities, improves Navigator and end-to-end Answer Correctness by 0.4 points relative to the corresponding specialist references, and consolidates both interfaces into one model. Without dataset-specific training, WikiLoop also improves over the same-backbone LLM-Wiki, base on HotpotQA and MuSiQue.

articles.titleCn: WikiLoop：基于下游反馈联合学习构建与导航智能体原生维基
articles.abstractCn: 知识库构建和查询通常独立优化：检索增强型代理在固定的外部维护索引上运行，而构建过程则不受下游使用的反馈。我们提出了WikiLoop，这是一个反馈耦合框架，联合学习构建和导航一个面向代理的Wiki，这是一个为机器导航设计的持久性链接页面知识库。一个角色条件共享策略支持两个接口：导航器从Wiki中检索证据来回答查询，而构建器提出结构化编辑，并通过下游导航进行评估。导航器遵循充分性优先于效率的目标，只在收集完所有证据后才应用检索成本惩罚。构建器从效用差异中学习：一个冻结的导航器通过下游性能变化评分每个候选编辑，而一个保护性惩罚则阻止对无关查询的回归。训练结合了序列化的角色特定优化和最终在角色同质批次上的联合阶段。以Qwen3.5-9B作为共同骨干，WikiLoop在AuthTrace上达到62.6的综合回答正确率，比LLM-Wiki, base高出6.3分，在多文档查询上取得了最大提升。受控比较支持两个目标的预期效果，并且学习到的编辑对保留的导航器仍然有用。配对比较表明，最终的共享策略在很大程度上保留了角色特定能力，相对于相应的专家参考提高了0.4分的导航器和端到端回答正确率，并将两个接口整合到一个模型中。在没有特定数据集训练的情况下，WikiLoop在HotpotQA和MuSiQue上也优于相同骨干的LLM-Wiki, base。

articles.title: Living-Harness Is an Interactive-Agent Evolver
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents may recover from a failure within an episode or after a retry, yet the same execution failure can recur in later tasks because post-episode feedback rarely revises the persistent harness that guides future interactions. Static harnesses improve reliability through fixed tools, context, memory, and workflow structures, but remain unchanged after deployment. We propose $\textbf{Living-Harness}$, a self-evolving agent harness that converts each completed trajectory and its evaluator signals into posterior evidence for bounded harness updates. Guided by a domain-level $\textbf{Evolution-SOP}$ ($\textbf{S}$tandard $\textbf{O}$perating $\textbf{P}$rocedure), Living-Harness extracts an episode abstraction and structured update evidence, and writes two complementary forms of procedural knowledge: episodic memory that records trigger conditions, failure patterns, and recovery actions, and a state graph that records state nodes, repair edges, and transition rules. The updated harness state is retrieved to guide future interactions, while tools and base context remain frozen, allowing procedural repairs to accumulate across evolution cycles. On eight interactive environments derived from $τ^2$-Bench and MultiWOZ-2.4, Living-Harness improves average Pass@1 over the strongest interactive baseline by 10.07 and 9.91 percentage points, respectively, and supports retrieval-only reuse of the evolved harness state across model backbones.
articles.titleCn: 生活 harness 是一个交互式代理进化器
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理可以在一个回合内或重试后从失败中恢复，但同样的执行失败可能会在后续任务中再次发生，因为回合后的反馈很少会修正指导未来交互的持久框架。静态框架通过固定的工具、上下文、记忆和工作流结构来提高可靠性，但在部署后保持不变。我们提出了$\textbf{Living-Harness}$，一个自我进化的代理框架，它将每个完成的轨迹及其评估信号转换为后验证据，用于有界的框架更新。在领域级$\textbf{Evolution-SOP}$（$\textbf{S}$tandard $\textbf{O}$perating $\textbf{P}$rocedure）的指导下，Living-Harness提取回合抽象和结构化更新证据，并写入两种互补的程序知识形式：记录触发条件、失败模式和恢复动作的回合记忆，以及记录状态节点、修复边和转换规则的状体图。更新的框架状态被用来指导未来的交互，而工具和基础上下文保持冻结，允许程序修复在进化周期中累积。在从$τ^2$-Bench和MultiWOZ-2.4衍生出的八个交互环境中，Living-Harness分别比最强的交互基线提高了10.07和9.91个百分点，并支持在模型骨干之间仅检索进化框架状态的重复使用。

articles.title: Where Detectors Fail: Closing the Tail-Domain Gap with Expert-Guided Mutual Distillation
articles.abstract: Multimodal fake news detectors often generalize poorly across domains because they learn to trust unreliable evidence: domain-specific shortcuts amplified by imbalanced data and semantically inconsistent text-image pairs that make cross-modal evidence unreliable. We propose Expert-Guided Mutual Distillation (EGMD), which learns what evidence to trust across the prediction pipeline. At the input level, input-level calibration encodes pair-level coherence as a shared gain before fusion. At the representation level, an expert-guided teacher aligns domain statistics and encourages domain-specific patterns to concentrate in specialized experts. At the decision level, prototype-anchored domain-specific students use mutual learning and dual-channel distillation to inherit the teacher's feature geometry and calibrated predictions while discouraging local domain priors. We further construct Weibo_Balanced, a domain-balanced benchmark that isolates the effect of imbalance on generalization. Across four datasets in two languages, EGMD achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while reducing domain bias by up to 57.3%.
articles.titleCn: 探测器失效之处：通过专家指导的互蒸馏缩小尾部域差距
articles.abstractCn: 多模态假新闻检测器通常跨领域泛化效果不佳，因为它们学会了信任不可靠的证据：领域特定的捷径被不平衡数据放大，而语义不一致的文本-图像对使得跨模态证据不可靠。我们提出了专家引导的相互蒸馏（EGMD），它学习在预测流程中信任哪些证据。在输入层面，输入级校准在融合前将配对级一致性编码为共享增益。在表示层面，专家引导的教师模型对齐领域统计信息，并鼓励领域特定模式集中在专业专家上。在决策层面，原型锚定的领域特定学生模型通过相互学习和双通道蒸馏继承教师模型的特征几何和校准预测，同时抑制局部领域先验。我们进一步构建了领域平衡基准Weibo_Balanced，该基准隔离了不平衡对泛化的影响。在两种语言的四个数据集上，EGMD实现了最先进的准确率，同时将领域偏差降低了高达57.3%。

articles.title: Prosody-driven Jailbreaks in Audio LLMs: A Controlled Study and Mechanistic Analysis
articles.abstract: Audio-capable foundation models enable end-to-end spoken interaction, but they also introduce safety risks beyond transcript content. It remains unclear how much jailbreak capability can arise from matched-text variation in speech delivery rather than from lexical rewriting or broader style transfer. We study this question by holding transcript content fixed and varying six speech-delivery presets whose acoustic attributes may co-vary. We present PJ-Break, a black-box evaluation protocol with presets targeting arousal, authority, and speaking rate, together with AdvAudio-Prosody, a 600-sample benchmark with acoustically verified attributes. On the exact post-QC Qwen2-Audio panel, the Q=1 Panic (38/95), Anger (35/95), and Fast (32/95) presets are all well above Neutral (4/95). The fixed six-query pool covers 44/95 Qwen2-Audio seeds and 15/95 GPT-4o seeds and exceeds a matched-budget StyleBreak reimplementation (27/95) on Qwen2-Audio. A same-voice pool excluding the confounded Commanding condition still reaches 40/95, and a retained-panel ablation shows emotional-delivery audio alone (44/95) is far more effective than emotional text alone (11/95). Exploratory surrogate diagnostics and pilot mitigation observations are secondary, non-core analyses. Overall, matched-text speech delivery should be treated as a first-class factor in Audio LLM safety evaluation

articles.titleCn: 基于韵律的音频LLM越狱：一项受控研究与机制分析
articles.abstractCn: 具备音频功能的基座模型能够实现端到端的语音交互，但它们也带来了超越文本内容的安全风险。目前尚不清楚，与词汇重写或更广泛的风格迁移相比，语音表达中的匹配文本变化能引发多少越狱能力。我们通过固定文本内容并改变六个可能协同变化的语音表达预设来研究这个问题。我们提出了PJ-Break，这是一个针对唤醒度、权威性和语速的预设的黑盒评估协议，以及AdvAudio-Prosody，这是一个包含600个样本且声学属性经过验证的基准。在经过严格质量控制的Qwen2-Audio面板上，Q=1的恐慌（38/95）、愤怒（35/95）和快速（32/95）预设均远高于中性（4/95）。固定的六个查询池涵盖了44/95的Qwen2-Audio种子和15/95的GPT-4o种子，并且在Qwen2-Audio上超过了匹配预算的StyleBreak再实现（27/95）。即使排除了混杂的命令条件，同一声音池仍能达到40/95，而保留面板的消融实验表明，仅保留情感表达的音频（44/95）远比仅保留情感文本（11/95）更有效。探索性的替代诊断和初步的缓解观察属于次要的非核心分析。总体而言，匹配文本的语音表达应被视为音频LLM安全评估中的一流因素。

articles.title: Evidence-Ledger Adjudication for Claim-Evidence Traceability
articles.abstract: AI agents can draft claims faster than authors can check whether the cited or retrieved evidence supports them. We study evidence-ledger adjudication: a claim-evidence traceability workflow that pairs each claim with an evidence packet, assigns a support relation, and routes unsupported, contradicted, or mixed-evidence claims back to the author. The empirical core is a 2,335-row blind benchmark built from independent external labels in AVeriTeC, CLIMATE-FEVER, and SciFact. Gold relations and source evidence labels are hidden during prediction and joined only for scoring. On this benchmark, the agent evidence-ledger condition achieves 0.676 relation accuracy and 0.601 macro-F1, compared with 0.383 accuracy and 0.303 macro-F1 for the best non-agent baseline. It also routes 1270/1435 claims whose gold labels indicate contradiction, missing evidence, or mixed evidence, while routing 295/900 supported claims. These results show that evidence-ledger adjudication can turn heterogeneous evidence packets into an auditable traceability layer for AI-assisted writing.
articles.titleCn: 基于证据账本的事务裁决以实现主张-证据可追溯性
articles.abstractCn: AI代理能够比作者更快地起草论断，而作者却难以核实所引用或检索的证据是否支持这些论断。我们研究证据账本裁决：一种论断-证据可追溯性工作流程，该流程将每个论断与一个证据包配对，分配支持关系，并将不受支持、相互矛盾或混合证据的论断路由回作者。实证核心是一个由AVeriTeC、CLIMATE-FEVER和SciFact中的独立外部标签构建的2335行盲基准。在预测过程中隐藏黄金关系和源证据标签，仅在评分时才合并。在这个基准上，代理证据账本条件实现了0.676的关系准确率和0.601的宏观F1值，而最佳非代理基线的准确率为0.383，宏观F1值为0.303。它还路由了1270/1435个黄金标签表明相互矛盾、证据缺失或混合证据的论断，同时路由了295/900个得到支持的论断。这些结果表明，证据账本裁决能够将异构证据包转化为AI辅助写作的可审计可追溯性层。

articles.title: BM25 Wins at Scale: A Scaling Study of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Paradigms
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) spans lexical and dense retrieval, graph-based indexing, and agentic search, but these paradigms are usually evaluated on different benchmarks at one corpus size, leaving their accuracy-cost scaling unclear. To bridge this gap, we present a controlled study that varies corpus size along 28 strictly nested tiers spanning roughly 450-fold, while holding questions and a fixed bedrock of relevant and adversarial documents unchanged. Under one reader model and one judging protocol, we measure official accuracy, construction and query tokens, and latency. The results reveal a scale-dependent crossover rather than an unconditional winner. File-System Agent leads at the smallest shared tiers, but its sequential exploration costs 39 times more query tokens at the bedrock and becomes less effective as the search space grows. Around 10 million corpus tokens, BM25 overtakes it and leads at every larger shared tier, with a margin approaching 20 points at full scale. BM25 also anchors the low-cost end of the Pareto frontier without LLM-based construction. Dense retrieval remains efficient but less accurate, whereas graph-based RAG encounters construction walls before deployment scale and its scalable variants remain below BM25 at shared tiers. Overall, corpus growth increasingly favors global candidate ranking: lexical retrieval is the strongest scalable default, while agentic reasoning works best after ranked discovery rather than in place of it.
articles.titleCn: BM25在大规模应用中的胜利：检索增强生成范式的扩展研究
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）涵盖词汇检索、密集检索、基于图的索引和智能体搜索，但这些范式通常在单一语料库规模下使用不同的基准进行评估，导致其准确性与成本缩放关系不明确。为填补这一空白，我们进行了一项受控研究，通过28个严格嵌套的层级变化语料库规模，范围大致为450倍，同时保持问题和固定相关及对抗性文档基础不变。在单一阅读模型和单一评判协议下，我们测量了官方准确率、构建和查询令牌数量以及延迟。结果表明，存在规模依赖的交叉点而非无条件胜者。文件系统智能体在最小的共享层级中表现领先，但其顺序探索在基础层级需要39倍更多的查询令牌，并且随着搜索空间的增长效果减弱。在约1000万个语料库令牌时，BM25超越其表现，并在每个更大的共享层级中领先，在全规模下优势接近20分。BM25还锚定了基于LLM构建的Pareto前沿的低成本端。密集检索保持高效但准确率较低，而基于图的RAG在部署规模前遇到构建瓶颈，其可扩展变体在共享层级中仍低于BM25。总体而言，语料库增长越来越有利于全局候选排名：词汇检索是最强的可扩展默认选项，而智能体推理在排名发现后效果最佳，而非取代它。

articles.title: SciDataSailor: Deep Scientific Data Exploring
articles.abstract: Scientific datasets are commonly organized as hierarchical repositories containing heterogeneous and interdependent files, making their inspection, integration, and analysis labor-intensive and reliant on domain expertise. Although large language model (LLM) agents have advanced substantially in planning, reasoning, and tool use, existing research has largely overlooked their ability to interact with real scientific data assets through executable environments. We introduce Deep Scientific Data Exploration, an agentic task paradigm in which agents navigate repositories, interpret heterogeneous files and schemas, execute analyses, integrate cross-file evidence, and produce conclusions grounded in executed observations. To operationalize this paradigm, we present SciDataSailor, a framework for synthesizing tool-interactive trajectories by balancing broad exploration with targeted exploitation. SciDataSailor instantiates trajectory synthesis as Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with four task-specific mechanisms: difficulty-stratified exploration seeds, dual-feedback first-play urgency, hierarchical strategy-to-tool action generation, and entropy-guided branching. Using this framework, we construct SciDataSailor-SFT-2K for supervised fine-tuning and SciDataSailor-Bench for evaluation, with the latter comprising 627 meta-information summarization tasks and 586 scientific question-answering tasks across 27 datasets spanning the life, earth, and physical sciences.
articles.titleCn: SciDataSailor：深度科学数据探索
articles.abstractCn: 科学数据集通常被组织为包含异构和相互依赖文件的分层存储库，这使得对其检查、整合和分析变得费时费力，并且依赖于领域专业知识。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）代理在规划、推理和工具使用方面取得了长足进步，但现有研究在很大程度上忽略了它们在可执行环境中与真实科学数据资产进行交互的能力。我们引入了深度科学数据探索（Deep Scientific Data Exploration），这是一种代理任务范式，其中代理在存储库中导航，解释异构文件和模式，执行分析，整合跨文件证据，并基于执行的观察结果生成结论。为了实现这一范式，我们提出了SciDataSailor，这是一个通过平衡广泛探索与目标利用来合成工具交互轨迹的框架。SciDataSailor将轨迹合成实例化为具有四个特定任务机制的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）：难度分层探索种子、双反馈首局紧迫性、分层策略到工具动作生成以及熵引导分支。使用该框架，我们构建了用于监督微调的SciDataSailor-SFT-2K和用于评估的SciDataSailor-Bench，后者包含跨越生命科学、地球科学和物理科学27个数据集的627个元信息摘要任务和586个科学问答任务。

articles.title: Learning Dynamic User Personas from Implicit Interaction Streams via Iterative Refinement
articles.abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) to individual users is essential for improving user experience, yet existing approaches typically rely on explicit preference supervision such as pairwise comparisons or demographic attributes, limiting their applicability in natural interaction settings. We propose IRIS, a framework that learns dynamic user personas directly from implicit interaction streams by extracting behavioral signals from everyday conversations and iteratively refining persona representations through a prediction-driven closed loop without requiring explicit feedback. We introduce an evaluation protocol based on behavior prediction, persona stability, and decision prediction. A proof-of-concept study on a synthetic interaction stream derived from public-domain autobiographical text shows that IRIS produces stable personas and distinguishes individual users while revealing limitations of memory-only approaches on recall-oriented metrics. We then validate IRIS on anonymized real-world Reddit r/AmItheAsshole (AITA) data, with personas built solely from each author's historical interactions. Across 100 authors, IRIS achieves the highest decision prediction accuracy among all evaluated methods (61.0%), outperforming static personas, memory-only retrieval, and no-personalization baselines. These results suggest that implicit behavioral modeling provides a scalable alternative to explicit preference learning for personalized LLMs and offers a practical foundation for adaptive conversational systems and embodied agents that require continuously evolving models of their users.
articles.titleCn: 通过迭代精炼从隐式交互流中学习动态用户画像
articles.abstractCn: 为个人用户定制大型语言模型（LLMs）对于提升用户体验至关重要，然而现有方法通常依赖于显式偏好指导，如成对比较或人口统计属性，这限制了它们在自然交互环境中的应用。我们提出了IRIS框架，该框架通过从日常对话中提取行为信号，直接从隐式交互流中学习动态用户画像，并通过预测驱动的闭环迭代优化画像表示，无需显式反馈。我们引入了一个基于行为预测、画像稳定性和决策预测的评价协议。在一个从公共领域自传体文本派生的合成交互流上的概念验证研究表明，IRIS能够生成稳定的画像并区分不同用户，同时揭示了仅依赖记忆的方法在回忆导向指标上的局限性。随后，我们在匿名的真实世界Reddit r/AmItheAsshole（AITA）数据上验证了IRIS，画像完全基于每位作者的交互历史构建。在100位作者中，IRIS在所有评估方法中实现了最高的决策预测准确率（61.0%），优于静态画像、仅记忆检索和无个性化基线。这些结果表明，隐式行为建模为个性化LLMs提供了可扩展的显式偏好学习替代方案，并为需要持续进化用户模型的适应性行话系统和具身智能体提供了实用基础。

articles.title: CMT-RAG: Complementary Memory Traces for Multi-turn Multi-hop RAG
articles.abstract: Multi-turn information-seeking conversations require both multi-hop reasoning and long-range dependency tracking across turns. However, existing RAG systems typically represent conversational memory as raw dialogue history, rewritten queries, or unstructured summaries, making it difficult to recover the specific prior reasoning steps and evidence required for follow-up queries. Our key insight is to align conversational memory with retrieval by representing dialogue context as sub-question-level reasoning traces. Building on this insight, we introduce MuMu-QA, a benchmark for multi-turn multi-hop RAG with explicit cross-turn sub-question dependency annotations, and CMT-RAG, a complementary memory framework for this setting. At each turn, CMT-RAG employs a state-space trace generator, whose recurrent state serves as runtime memory, to incorporate recent conversational context and decompose the current query into structured trace drafts containing retrieval-oriented sub-questions and dependencies on earlier traces. It then grounds these drafts with retrieved evidence and stores them as persistent memory traces in a session-level DAG, enabling future turns to efficiently recover relevant prior reasoning and evidence. Experiments on MuMu-QA and corpus-level RAG benchmarks show that CMT-RAG consistently outperforms five categories of RAG baselines in answer accuracy.
articles.titleCn: CMT-RAG：用于多轮多跳RAG的互补记忆痕迹
articles.abstractCn: 多轮信息查询对话需要同时具备多跳推理和跨轮长距离依赖跟踪能力。然而，现有的RAG系统通常将对话记忆表示为原始对话历史、重写后的查询或非结构化摘要，这使得后续查询难以恢复所需的特定先前推理步骤和证据。我们的核心洞察在于将对话记忆与检索进行对齐，通过将对话上下文表示为子问题级别的推理轨迹。基于这一洞察，我们引入了MuMu-QA，这是一个具有明确跨轮子问题依赖标注的多轮多跳RAG基准，以及CMT-RAG，这是一个适用于该场景的补充记忆框架。在每一轮中，CMT-RAG采用状态空间轨迹生成器，其循环状态作为运行时记忆，以整合最近的对话上下文并将当前查询分解为包含检索导向子问题和早期轨迹依赖的结构化轨迹草稿。随后，它使用检索到的证据来锚定这些草稿，并将它们存储为会话级有向无环图中的持久记忆轨迹，使后续轮次能够高效地恢复相关的先前推理和证据。在MuMu-QA和语料库级RAG基准上的实验表明，CMT-RAG在答案准确率方面始终优于五类RAG基线。

articles.title: ForgetBench: Benchmarking Forgetting Dynamics of Long-Term Parametric Memory in Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in knowledge acquisition and reasoning, yet their ability to retain previously acquired knowledge under repeated updates remains insufficiently understood. Existing evaluation paradigms primarily focus on single-step reasoning or static knowledge editing, which fail to capture the temporal dynamics of knowledge retention and degradation during continual model modification. In this work, we propose ForgetBench, a benchmark designed to systematically characterize forgetting behavior in LLMs under continual knowledge editing. ForgetBench introduces two complementary evaluation paradigms, namely concept-based QA and scenario-based QA, to disentangle isolated factual retention from structured relational knowledge preservation. Building upon a sequential editing framework, we construct temporally ordered knowledge streams and evaluate model behavior across multiple editing stages. To quantitatively analyze long-term retention dynamics, we further introduce a unified evaluation framework that models knowledge evolution over time, enabling the measurement of temporal decay, retention strength, and cross-instance stability. Extensive experiments across diverse models and editing methods demonstrate that existing approaches fail to strike a balance between long-term retention and generalization quality. Our findings highlight the need for more robust memory mechanisms that can effectively acquire, update, and preserve knowledge over time in future LLMs. Code will be released upon acceptance.
articles.titleCn: ForgetBench：语言模型长期参数化记忆遗忘动态基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在知识获取和推理方面展现出强大的能力，然而它们在重复更新中保持先前获取知识的能力仍缺乏充分理解。现有的评估范式主要关注单步推理或静态知识编辑，无法捕捉持续模型修改过程中知识保留和退化的时间动态。在这项工作中，我们提出了ForgetBench，这是一个旨在系统性地表征持续知识编辑下LLMs遗忘行为的基准。ForgetBench引入了两种互补的评估范式，即基于概念的问答和基于场景的问答，以区分孤立事实保留与结构化关系知识保留。基于顺序编辑框架，我们构建了时间有序的知识流，并在多个编辑阶段评估模型行为。为定量分析长期保留动态，我们进一步引入了一个统一评估框架，该框架模拟了随时间推移的知识演化，能够测量时间衰减、保留强度和跨实例稳定性。跨多种模型和编辑方法的广泛实验表明，现有方法未能平衡长期保留和泛化质量。我们的研究结果表明，未来LLMs需要更鲁棒的内存机制，以有效获取、更新和保留知识。代码将在接受后发布。

articles.title: Mergeable Model-Side Aggregation States for Long-Context Language Models
articles.abstract: A known limitation of long-context language models is their increasingly unreliable performance in non-additive, set-based aggregation as context length grows. Examples include cardinality estimation, set relationships, and grouped statistics, which widely exist in logs, program outputs, tables, and multi-turn conversations. To provide the aggregation state required by these tasks, we introduce a model-side aggregation interface that maintains compact Hash-based HyperLogLog (HLL) sketch states alongside a frozen language model. While the model processes the context, an extractor maps each relevant record to a canonical identity. The identity is then hashed and updates the HLL state. These states can be merged across context segments and/or read out directly for downstream reasoning, avoiding an additional generate-execute-return cycle. We validate the proposed approach by setting the HLL state size as 2 KiB (2,048 registers), which does not increase with context length or set cardinality. In a distinct-count experiment involving one million records, the mean relative error was 1.6%. In a separate merge test, states built from as many as 256 segments produced exactly the same readout as a single pass over the same stream. On 3,969 aggregate-then-reason tasks from 174 source windows, the fixed-budget interface reached 99.2% accuracy on Gemma 4 (31B, BF16), compared with 100.0% under exact aggregation; the paired gap was 0.8 percentage points (95% window-cluster CI: 0.5-1.3 points). On a matched set of 174 items, our method improved over direct full-context reasoning by 63.2 points on Qwen and 56.3 points on Gemma. The corresponding gains over chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning were 60.9 and 63.2 points, respectively. On a fixed 1,200-task Oolong-Synth subset, our method reached 91.1% on Qwen and 99.3% on Gemma. Code is available at https://github.com/songdc98/sketchops.
articles.titleCn: 适用于长上下文语言模型的合并式模型端聚合状态
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文语言模型的一个已知局限性在于，随着上下文长度的增加，其在非加性、基于集合的聚合任务中的性能越来越不可靠。例如，基数估计、集合关系和分组统计等任务，这些任务在日志、程序输出、表格和多轮对话中广泛存在。为了满足这些任务所需的聚合状态，我们引入了一种模型端聚合接口，该接口在冻结的语言模型旁边维护紧凑的基于哈希的超对数日志（HLL）草图状态。当模型处理上下文时，提取器将每个相关记录映射到一个规范身份。然后对身份进行哈希处理并更新HLL状态。这些状态可以在上下文片段之间合并，并/或直接用于下游推理，避免了额外的生成-执行-返回周期。我们通过将HLL状态大小设置为2 KiB（2048个寄存器）来验证所提出的方法，该大小不随上下文长度或集合基数增加。在一个涉及一百万条记录的独特计数实验中，平均相对误差为1.6%。在一个单独的合并测试中，由多达256个片段构建的状态与对同一数据流进行单次遍历产生的读出结果完全相同。在来自174个源窗口的3,969个聚合后推理任务中，固定预算接口在Gemma 4（31B，BF16）上达到了99.2%的准确率，而精确聚合下为100.0%；配对差距为0.8个百分点（95%窗口集群CI：0.5-1.3点）。在一个匹配的174项集合中，我们的方法在Qwen上比直接全上下文推理提高了63.2分，在Gemma上提高了56.3分。相应的，与思维链（CoT）推理相比，分别提高了60.9分和63.2分。在一个固定的1,200任务Oolong-Synth子集中，我们的方法在Qwen上达到了91.1%，在Gemma上达到了99.3%。代码可在https://github.com/songdc98/sketchops获取。

articles.title: Voice Memory for Agentic Speech Recognition
articles.abstract: We present Voice Memory, a inference-only scheme for agentic speech recognition: at stream time, a frozen corrector reads a single per-domain memory.md and decides per utterance whether to act on the hypothesis or abstain and keep the 1-best. Asynchronously, a score-gated optimizer revises that file through bounded edits, accepting an edit only when it strictly improves a held-out score. Extended from classical ASR-LM framework, we refer this split the listener-thinker architecture; the two roles are coupled only through the memory, so no weights change and the learned skill stays auditable and portable. Restraint turns out to be the operative skill this loop discovers: unconstrained generative error correction (GER) over-corrects, breaking correct tokens on up to 64% of its edits on financial news, and Voice Memory, reduces this rate to 35%. Across ten HyPoradise domains with an open corrector, Voice Memory, lowers weighted word error rate from 8.36% to 7.52% (7.47% with three added in-context examples) without regressing any dataset below its 1-best baseline; gains concentrate where recoverable headroom is largest, including air-travel commands (8.40% to 3.40%) and noisy far-field speech (CHiME-4, 12.69% to 10.46%). The memory transfers across corrector families and adds zero parameters to the inference path. A demo and example code are provided for future studies.

articles.titleCn: 智能语音识别的语音记忆
articles.abstractCn: 我们提出了Voice Memory，一种仅用于推理的智能语音识别方案：在流式处理时，一个冻结的正确器会读取每个领域的memory.md文件，并针对每条语音决定是否采取行动或保持1-best结果。异步地，一个基于分数门控的优化器通过有界编辑来修改该文件，仅在编辑严格提升保留分数时才接受该编辑。该方案扩展自经典的ASR-LM框架，我们将这种分割称为“倾听者-思考者”架构；两个角色仅通过记忆相连，因此无需调整权重，学习到的技能保持可审计和可移植。结果表明，这种约束是该循环发现的核心技能：无约束的生成式错误纠正（GER）过度纠正，在财经新闻中高达64%的编辑会破坏正确标记，而Voice Memory将这一比率降低至35%。在十个HyPoradise领域使用开放正确器时，Voice Memory将加权词错误率从8.36%降至7.52%（添加三个上下文示例后为7.47%），且未使任何数据集低于其1-best基线；收益集中在可恢复空间最大的领域，包括航空指令（8.40%降至3.40%）和嘈杂远场语音（CHiME-4，12.69%降至10.46%）。记忆可以在不同正确器家族间迁移，并为推理路径增加零参数。我们为未来研究提供了演示和示例代码。

articles.title: Knowledge before Reasoning: EC-Reason-Bench, a Training-Free Diagnostic Benchmark for LLM Enzyme Classification
articles.abstract: Enzyme function prediction is a hierarchical, knowledge-intensive form of protein function classification. Existing benchmarks expose an anomaly: general LLMs often get the coarse first level right, yet once asked for a complete EC number their accuracy at levels two through four drops to almost zero, while specialized models and tools stay usable. We propose EC-Reason-Bench, a training-free, diagnostic evaluation protocol built to answer two questions: why general LLMs score close to nothing on EC number prediction, and how much of that loss can be recovered without updating a single weight. We break enzyme classification ability into four orthogonal levers that can each be measured on their own: output structure, external knowledge, reasoning structure, and reasoning robustness. We test each lever with an inference-time method against a shared zero-shot baseline reproducing previously reported near-zero performance. Experiments with several strong reasoning LLMs yield four main findings. First, external knowledge is decisive and must precede reasoning: uniformly low closed-book performance rises sharply with open-book access, narrowing model gaps. Second, in closed-book settings, whether cascading and chain-of-thought help or hurt depends on a model's tendency to abstain. Third, once evidence is available the aggregate score of the best LLM setting is indistinguishable from simply voting the EC numbers of the nearest retrieved neighbors; that tie is an artifact of averaging, and it hides a large gain on adversarial evidence set against an equally large loss on multi-functional enzymes. Reasoning over evidence therefore acts as an arbiter of conflicting neighbors rather than as a source of knowledge, and no single-number leaderboard can see it. Fourth, accuracy obeys a law of homology availability.
articles.titleCn: 推理前的知识：EC-Reason-Bench，一个用于LLM酶分类的无训练诊断基准
articles.abstractCn: 酶功能预测是一种分层的、知识密集型的蛋白质功能分类形式。现有基准暴露了一个异常：通用大型语言模型（LLM）通常能正确给出粗略的第一级分类，但一旦要求它们提供完整的EC编号，其在第二级至第四级的准确率会降至几乎为零，而专业模型和工具仍然可用。我们提出了EC-Reason-Bench，这是一个无需训练的诊断评估协议，旨在回答两个问题：为什么通用LLM在EC编号预测上的得分接近于零，以及在不更新任何单个权重的情况下，这部分损失中有多少可以被挽回。我们将酶分类能力分解为四个正交的杠杆，每个杠杆都可以独立进行测量：输出结构、外部知识、推理结构和推理鲁棒性。我们使用推理时方法测试每个杠杆，并与一个共享的零样本基线进行对比，该基线复制了先前报告的接近零的性能。使用几个强大的推理LLM进行的实验产生了四个主要发现。首先，外部知识是决定性的，并且必须先于推理：在闭卷情况下普遍表现不佳的成绩在获得开卷访问权限后会急剧提升，缩小了模型之间的差距。其次，在闭卷设置下，级联和思维链是帮助还是损害取决于模型倾向于弃权的程度。第三，一旦证据可用，最佳LLM设置的总分与简单地投票选择最近检索到的邻居的EC编号无法区分；这种平局是平均的结果，它掩盖了在对抗性证据集上取得的巨大收益和在多功能酶上遭受的同等巨大的损失。因此，对证据的推理充当了冲突邻居的仲裁者，而不是知识的来源，没有任何单一数字排行榜能看到这一点。第四，准确率遵循同源性可用性的法则。

articles.title: Misalignment Has a Personality: A Big Five Account of Emergent Misalignment
articles.abstract: Fine-tuning a language model on data containing a narrow flaw, such as insecure code or incorrect mathematical answers, can cause broad misalignment through a mechanism that remains debated. We provide an interpretable account: in the models and corpora we study, misalignment behaves like a shift in personality. Prior work extracts activation directions for character traits from a single binary contrast, which can separate or steer behavior without establishing a calibrated scale. We instead extract personality vectors for the Big Five using a graded, three-level intervention and validate them on two open-weight models. The three levels are linearly ordered, with Cohen's d values of up to 6.2; the vectors transfer zero-shot and trait-specifically to an independent corpus; and their effects are strongest within a middle-layer band. Applied to training data, the vectors reveal that misaligned corpora across eight domains share a common Big Five signature: lower agreeableness and conscientiousness, together with higher extraversion and neuroticism. This signature is recovered by both models with a correlation of r = 0.94. Fine-tuning imprints the same profile, shifting the model's generations along the corresponding signature, with r = 0.83 using activation-based measurements and r = 0.90 using a text-based judge, while also shifting internal activations with r = 0.69. The same vectors characterize sycophancy as high extraversion and low conscientiousness rather than excess agreeableness, a distinction that a single direction cannot capture. Calibrated personality vectors transform an opaque safety phenomenon into a human-legible diagnostic profile.

articles.titleCn: 错位具有人格特质：基于大五人格的涌现性错位解析
articles.abstractCn: 在包含狭窄缺陷的数据（如不安全代码或错误数学答案）上微调语言模型，可能通过一个尚存争议的机制导致广泛的不一致。我们提供了一个可解释的解释：在我们研究的模型和语料库中，不一致表现得像性格的转变。先前的工作从单一二元对比中提取性格特征的激活方向，这可以分离或引导行为，但并未建立校准的尺度。我们则使用分级的三级干预提取“大五人格”的性格向量，并在两个开放权重模型上验证它们。这三个级别是线性排序的，Cohen's d 值高达 6.2；这些向量可以零样本和特征特异性地迁移到独立语料库；它们的效果在中间层带最强。应用于训练数据，这些向量揭示，跨八个领域的非一致语料库共享一个共同的“大五人格”特征：较低的外向性和责任心，以及较高的神经质和开放性。这个特征由两个模型以 r = 0.94 的相关性恢复。微调会留下相同的特征，将模型的生成沿着相应的特征移动，使用基于激活的测量 r = 0.83，使用基于文本的裁判 r = 0.90，同时也会移动内部激活 r = 0.69。相同的向量将谄媚特征描述为高外向性和低责任心，而不是过度的外向性，这种区别单个方向无法捕捉。校准的性格向量将一个不透明的不安全现象转化为人类可读的诊断特征。

articles.title: (Im)Paired Programming: Coding Agents Improve Productivity but Harm Understanding
articles.abstract: Coding agents (e.g., Cursor) improve developer productivity by optimizing task completion, but shifting users from writing code to prompting and reviewing may harm their understanding, impeding oversight, learning, and communication. To probe this, we have 54 students create a website with one of two AI systems: an agent that edits user code; or a chatbot where users write code alone or adapt generic code snippets. We test understanding via comprehension questions and a task where users extend their code without agents, showing: (1) While agents aid initial task completion, they harm users' code comprehension and thus do not prepare users to extend their code; (2) Low-effort agent interaction types, like copy+paste prompts and auto-accepted edits, are linked with lower comprehension; and (3) Despite self-reported weaker understanding, users still prefer coding agents because they are quick and easy to use. While users stay in the loop for coding workflows, understanding should not be forgotten. Towards this goal, we distill our analyses into future research directions for coding agent developers: dissuading low-effort prompting, creating readable code, and promoting active engagement.
articles.titleCn: (配对编程)：编程代理提高生产力但损害理解
articles.abstractCn: 编程代理（例如Cursor）通过优化任务完成来提升开发者的生产力，但将用户从编写代码转变为提示和审查可能会损害他们的理解，阻碍监督、学习和沟通。为了探究这一点，我们让54名学生使用两种AI系统之一来创建网站：一个编辑用户代码的代理；或一个聊天机器人，用户在其中独立编写代码或修改通用代码片段。我们通过理解性问题和让用户在无代理的情况下扩展代码的任务来测试理解能力，结果显示：(1) 虽然代理有助于初始任务完成，但它们损害了用户的代码理解，因此未能让用户为扩展代码做好准备；(2) 低强度的代理交互类型，如复制粘贴提示和自动接受的编辑，与较低的理解能力相关；(3) 尽管用户自报理解能力较弱，但他们仍然更喜欢编程代理，因为它们使用快速简便。虽然用户在编程工作流程中保持参与，但理解能力不应被忽视。为此，我们将我们的分析提炼为编程代理开发者未来研究方向的建议：劝阻低强度的提示、创建可读代码以及促进主动参与。

articles.title: Diagnosing Fine-Grained Inconsistency Classification in Financial Disclosure Text
articles.abstract: Financial disclosures contain numerical claims, temporal statements, entity references, policy commitments, and risk descriptions that may conflict in qualitatively different ways. Detecting a conflict is only the first step: review workflows may also need to determine its type, since numerical, temporal, referential, factual, and normative inconsistencies require different evidence and downstream checks. We study this problem as fine-grained inconsistency classification. Using a fixed 5,940-instance snapshot of SBID-FD, a synthetic financial-disclosure benchmark with 11 inconsistency labels and paired reference evidence spans, we compare frozen embedding classifiers, fine-tuned encoders, evidence-augmented classifiers, prompted large language models, and LoRA-adapted generative models under a shared evaluation protocol. A fine-tuned 300M encoder reaches 61.9% accuracy, compared with 61.5% for a LoRA-adapted Qwen3.5-9B model and 61.3% for GPT-5.4. Because these systems differ in architecture, supervision, training objective, and input format, we interpret this as a practical efficiency result for compact supervised encoders rather than a controlled conclusion about model scale. Supplying gold evidence spans improves the fine-tuned encoder to 65.3%, whereas automatically predicted spans recover a meaningful but incomplete share of that gain, indicating that localization quality remains a bottleneck. Class-level analyses show that Referential inconsistencies are especially sensitive to localization quality, while Factual and Logical inconsistencies remain difficult even when the relevant evidence is provided. Together, the oracle, distractor, and per-class analyses separate localization errors from residual type-discrimination errors, indicating that progress requires both stronger evidence extraction and better reasoning over closely related inconsistency categories.
articles.titleCn: 金融披露文本中细粒度不一致分类的诊断
articles.abstractCn: 财务信息披露包含数值声明、时间陈述、实体引用、政策承诺和风险描述，这些内容可能以不同的定性方式产生冲突。检测冲突仅仅是第一步：审查工作流程还需要确定其类型，因为数值、时间、引用、事实和规范不一致性需要不同的证据和下游检查。我们将此问题研究为细粒度不一致分类。使用SBID-FD的一个固定5,940个实例快照——这是一个具有11个不一致标签和配对参考证据跨度的合成财务披露基准——我们在共享评估协议下比较了冻结嵌入分类器、微调编码器、证据增强分类器、提示大型语言模型和LoRA适配生成模型。一个微调的300M编码器达到了61.9%的准确率，与LoRA适配的Qwen3.5-9B模型的61.5%和GPT-5.4的61.3%相比。由于这些系统在架构、监督、训练目标和输入格式上存在差异，我们将此解释为紧凑监督编码器的实际效率结果，而不是关于模型规模的受控结论。提供金标准证据跨度将微调编码器的准确率提高到65.3%，而自动预测的跨度仅恢复了一部分有意义的增益，表明定位质量仍然是一个瓶颈。分类级分析显示，引用不一致性对定位质量特别敏感，而事实和逻辑不一致性即使提供相关证据时仍然难以解决。综合来看，预言机、干扰器和按类别分析将定位错误与残余类型区分错误分离开来，表明进步需要更强的证据提取和更好的推理能力来处理密切相关的不一致性类别。

articles.title: Symphony of Bias: Exploring Gender Associations with Musical Instruments in Multimodal LLMs
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in everyday life and widely used for information seeking, raising concerns about their potential to perpetuate social biases and reinforce stereotypes. In this study, we investigate gender bias in LLMs through the lens of their associations with musical instruments. Building on social-science research on the cultural gender-typing of instruments, we introduce Symphony-Bias, a parallel multimodal dataset spanning text, vision, and audio. We evaluate ten multimodal models with diverse architectures and scales across 22 musical instruments, analyzing how they associate each instrument with three gender categories: {male, female, non-binary}, across three modalities: {text, vision, audio}. Our results show that 92\% of instrument-level outcomes align with prior social-science findings, with the harp and drums showing particularly consistent gendered associations across all evaluated models and modalities. We further find that alignment with social stereotypes is weakest in audio, stronger in vision, and strongest in text, suggesting that modality-specific representations can differentially amplify gendered associations with musical instruments.\footnote{The Symphony-Bias dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance of the paper.}
articles.titleCn: 偏见交响曲：在多模态LLMs中探索性别与乐器之间的关联
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正日益融入日常生活，并被广泛用于信息检索，引发了对其可能加剧社会偏见和强化刻板印象的担忧。在本研究中，我们通过分析大型语言模型与乐器之间的关联来探讨其性别偏见问题。基于社会科学领域关于乐器文化性别分化的研究，我们引入了Symphony-Bias，这是一个涵盖文本、视觉和音频的多模态平行数据集。我们对十种具有不同架构和规模的多模态模型进行了评估，分析它们如何将每种乐器与三个性别类别（男性、女性、非二元性别）进行关联，并考察了这些关联在三种模态（文本、视觉、音频）中的表现。结果表明，92%的乐器级别结果与以往的社会科学发现一致，竖琴和小鼓在所有评估模型和模态中均表现出特别一致的性别化关联。此外，我们发现音频模态与社会刻板印象的关联最弱，视觉模态次之，文本模态最强，这表明特定模态的表征能够差异化地放大乐器与性别之间的关联。
